description: Creates an alert on the linked SupaPark account for a Walt Disney World ride. kind "lightning_lane": alert when Lightning Lane return times open up (optionally for a specific date). kind "wait_drop": alert when the standby wait drops to threshold_minutes or less. Delivery channel follows the account's plan. Requires a linked SupaPark account (pairing key).

date.description: lightning_lane only: YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the next opening.

name: watch_ride
title: Watch a ride
